feature.name: ex_issuer_peer_breadth_acceleration
feature.formula: a = b_now - b_prev; breadth = fixed-owner-weight share of peer issuers outperforming same-endpoint SPY
feature.membership: one owner-declared primary group, same decision-eligible snapshot and weights in both windows
feature.exclude: all listings of the focal economic issuer

configurations: C1 C0 information plus current ex-issuer peer breadth
C2 C1 information plus breadth acceleration
auxiliary_cannot_rescue: incumbent on genuinely comparable scored domain
comparison.model_proposal: date-weighted ridge; intercept unpenalized; training-only standardization; lambda=1; no tuning sweep

endpoint.statistic: equally date-weighted paired difference in decision-frozen top-five SPY-excess marks
endpoint.missing_selected_label: unresolved paired date; do not reselect sixth-ranked name or call unknown cash
endpoint.secondary: coverage, concentration, downside, turnover/fillability context; cannot rescue primary

consumer.unresolved_benchmark_caveat: SPY reindex/ffill; require exact endpoint/calendar witness or owner-versioned correction

gates: B09 original membership, primary-group, coverage and two-clock manifest
B01/Data OS listing/issuer mapping and correction lineage
B10 exact feature/fit implementation and partition binding
B06 native key/label maturity and benchmark exactness
D08 cost/fill/latency contract for any economic claim
next_action: Existing Packet3 accepts/rejects the intake and returns the source/registration bindings; no numerical trial starts before those gates close.
